note: Placeholder numbers. Tuned with the bot from M1 onward. happy_amount and happy_uses_per_turn are what a happy villager adds (specs/bridge.md section 4). cost_amount is what the perk costs (Chum: +1 enemy attack), and die is the dice row a die_faces perk puts in place of die 0 or an add_die perk adds last (specs/bridge.md section 3). Villagers give the first four, shops the rest.

items.name: Nudge
items.text: Once per turn, raise one die by 1.

items.name: Foresight
items.text: See one extra room ahead on the delve map.

items.name: Weighted die
items.text: Your first die rolls 2, 3, 3, 4, 4 or 5. Steadier, but never a 6.

items.name: Slow pour
items.text: In fights, reroll without spending a die, twice per fight. It replaces the usual reroll.

items.name: Chum
items.text: Treasure rooms pay 1 more of each resource they pay, but every enemy hits 1 harder.

items.name: Spare die
items.text: Take a fifth die down, a d4. It sits out of Koban's vault.
